# Momentum
> A daily fitness habit tracker for adults over 40. Pick up to three habits, check in once a day, and build a streak. Free: 3 habits. Premium: $7.99 per month or $69.99 per year. Independently built by Chad T. Dyar. https://momentumfit.app
